policy.en: No synthetic contributor profile cards. Select at most one verified person image per event. Keep text-only contributors when identity, source, license, or affiliation cannot be verified.
policy.zh: 不生成合成人物资料卡。每个事件最多选择一张通过校验的人物图片；身份、来源、许可或机构无法确认时，仅保留文字人物信息。

reliabilityRules: Wikidata candidates require an AI/computing research description and at least one event-institution match.
Wikimedia candidates require a file page with explicit license metadata.
Curated local candidates require an official institution profile, researcher-owned account/site, or explicit user-provided provenance.
Legacy reference images and source-review-needed portraits are not selected.
